messages:
olivia: quick question — trying to finalize span naming + attr set for LLM requests that pass through the router/quota layer. want something human-readable but also stable for exporters and retention filters. any strong opinions?

marc: +1 on stable. we should be able to slice by routing policy, quota bucket, and whether KV cache hit.

sara: agree. also need model-level granularity for evals (family vs variant). for billing & sampling we usually only need family, but for regressions we need exact variant.

lee: proposal sketch: span name = `llm.inference.request` for the end-to-end request span, and use attributes for routing/fallback details. avoids exploding span-name permutations.

marc: yh, keep names small and semantic attrs rich. exporters can filter on attributes. example attrs i care about: `routing.policy`, `fallback.model`, `quota.bucket`, `quota.reason`, `kvcache.hits`, `kvcache.requests`, `model.family`, `model.variant`, `model.quantized`, `tokens.prompt`, `tokens.completion`, `tokens.total`.

olivia: putting sample payload for folks to react to:

```
span.name: llm.inference.request
attributes:
  service.name: redwood-runtime
  routing.policy: "latency_safe"
  routing.node: "us-west-2a/router-12"
  fallback.model: "gptx-mini-v2"
  quota.bucket: "free-tier"
  quota.reason: "rate_limit"
  kvcache.hits: "3"
  kvcache.requests: "5"
  model.family: "redwood-alpha"
  model.variant: "redwood-alpha-1.2-q8"
  model.quantized: "true"
  tokens.prompt: "48"
  tokens.completion: "120"
  tokens.total: "168"
  request.sampling_priority: "1"
```

lee: that looks good. one nit: numeric attrs should be numeric in OTEL, not strings. make sure the schema says `kvcache.hits` -> int, tokens -> int. exporters will depend on types for aggregation.

marc: +1. also add `routing.decision` for why routed (e.g., capacity, locality, cost). helps when we trigger auto-fallbacks.

olivia: what about span sub-structure for batching? a single top-level `llm.inference.request` might contain multiple item-level spans (e.g., `llm.inference.item`) for per-prompt metrics. we want both costs and latency broken down per item.

sara: we already have continuous batching in runtime. i propose: top-level span = request, and create child spans named `llm.inference.item` with `item.index` and `item.tokens.*`. keeps the aggregation clean.

marc: sampling rules: keep 100% for error spans and 5% for success by default, but always keep any span where `quota.bucket` != "standard" or `kvcache.hits` == 0 for a longer retention window. that lets us catch regressions when cache disappears.

olivia: exporter concerns: ops wants to drop `tokens.*` for PII-ish prompts in hosted logs; can we add `sensitive.redact=true` attribute when prompt contains user data? or we should instrument redaction earlier so exporters never see raw prompt tokens.

lee: redact upstream in runtime. add `data.sensitivity: "high|low"` attribute and ensure exporter config filters accordingly. avoid ad-hoc string checks in exporters.

marc: retention policy suggestion: index key attrs (strings) only: `service.name`, `model.family`, `routing.policy`, `quota.bucket`, `kvcache.hits>0` as boolean, and numeric rollups for tokens/kvcache. keep raw per-request spans for 7 days, aggregated metrics for 90 days, and sampled long-tail spans (errors, fallback, cold cache) for 180 days.

olivia: question for devs: should we standardize on `model.variant` being full canonical name (with quant suffix) and `model.family` short? or the other way around?

sara: make `model.variant` canonical, `model.family` short. tools will often filter by family.

marc: small naming note: use dot-delimited keys, not snake_case or camelCase. e.g., `model.variant`, `kvcache.hits`. makes OTEL search easier in most backends.

lee: actionable: i can land a proto change in runtime to emit these attrs as typed fields. olivia can you draft a short exporters README that lists required attributes + retention hints? i'll add sampling hooks.

olivia: yep i'll draft and share in this thread. rough timeline: PR by EOD Fri, exporters README Monday.

dev-bot: deploy-preview created by lee for runtime-emit-llm-attrs (PR #842)

marc: nice. once PR lands we'll add a small dashboard card in console: cache hit ratio by model.family and routing.policy. good visibility for product.

olivia: thanks all — this clears up a lot. i'll post the README link here when ready.

lee: fyi i'll include a small example of retention config for exporters (otlp -> metrics store) in the PR.
